name: ListBox
summary: A standalone list of options with sections, descriptions and icons — choose none, one or many, or use it as a list of actions.

a11y.keyboardNote: One tab stop (the active option). Arrows, Home and End move; Space and Enter choose (toggle in multiple); a letter jumps to the next option starting with it. Disabled options are skipped. Sections are role=group named by their title.

props.name: label
props.description: REQUIRED. The list's name for screen readers.

props.name: items
props.description: Options ({id, label, description?, icon?, disabled?, danger?, textValue?, kbd?}) and sections ({title, items}). kbd shows the item's shortcut at the end of the row, as the reference — display only; the app binds the key.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: none turns it into a list of actions (onAction).

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: The ids of the chosen options.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new list of ids.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when an option is activated (Enter, Space or click).
